lines.text: Excuse me, does this bus go to the music room near West Park?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Do you mean the music shop? The shop is near Green Street.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I mean the place where people go for music lessons. It is next to a bakery.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Oh, yes. Get off at Lake Road, and walk past the small park.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Could you say the stop again? Did you say Lake Road or Lake Street?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Lake Road. There is a big blue sign at the stop, so it is easy to see.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Thanks. I get off at Lake Road, and the room is by the bakery, right?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, that is right. The music room is on the second floor.
lines.speaker: Eli
